screen.handheldmoon.device_config.title: Device Configuration
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.ligh: The opening angle of the light cone (in degrees), controls beam width.
Provide one or more RRGGBBAA hex colors; multiple colors blend softly from apex to base.
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.enab: Enable dynamic real lighting. In-game: hold '%s' and Left Mouse to toggle.
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.real: Value 0-15; controls dynamic light brightness and effective coverage. Lower values reduce rebuild area and may improve performance.
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.laye: List of per-layer size multipliers, e.g. 1.00,1.06,1.12.
List of per-layer edge alpha values (0-1).
Optional per-layer RRGGBBAA colors. Leave empty to use palette with noise blending.
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.colo: Strength of irregular color wobble along the ring (0-1).
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.fogE: Adds a subtle outer fog layer for fuller look.
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.fogS: Size multiplier for the fog layer.
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.fogC: Fog color, e.g. FFFFFF80 for semi-transparent white.
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.ligh: Post-processing brightness multiplier. In-game: hold '%s' and scroll to adjust.
config.handheldmoon.client_settings.enab: Compute occlusion for beams. Performance-sensitive in complex terrain.
Clip cone to blocks via ray casts; improves realism but may jitter and impact performance.
